npcs.name: Ferryman Osk
npcs.title: Ferry

actions.text: No crossing today. The tide is wrong and there is fog on the water. Maybe tomorrow.
The ferry runs whenever the tide allows. Walk onto the pier when you want to head back to the colosseum.

npcs.line: The ferry runs when the tide allows.

npcs.name: Elder Mahina
npcs.title: Village Elder
npcs.line: Welcome to Paradise Island. Walk the old road north if you're brave: the ruins, and the cave beyond, have swallowed more than one fighter.

actions.text: Traveller, you arrive at a good hour. Young Lani went into the Hollow Cave three days ago to gather moonglow moss, and she has not come back.
The cave runs deep: at its end lies the crypt of the old drowned king, and his court still walks. Take your party, fight through, and bring her home. The road north leads to the cave mouth.
Lani is still down there. Follow the road north to the cave. The crypt's guardians are restless, so do not be hasty.
You look weary. Sit by my fire and rest. Your wounds will mend and your strength return.
Raiders in masks! Drive them off, quickly!

npcs.name: Pua
npcs.title: Fisher
npcs.line: Biting well today. Don't tell the gulls.

npcs.name: Kai
npcs.title: Island Trader
npcs.line: Coconuts, shells, and rumours from the mainland. The rumours are free.

npcs.name: Old Tane
npcs.title: Hermit
npcs.line: They say the oldest palm on the island remembers every storm. I just sit under it.

npcs.name: Scholar Nema
npcs.title: Ruins scholar
npcs.line: These ruins are older than the colosseum, older than the ladder. The tunnel behind me goes down to a flooded court.

actions.text: Beyond this arch the old crypt begins. Restless guardians wander it, and at its heart a drowned king keeps his throne.
Bring your whole party. Fights down there do not end until one side stands. Step into the tunnel when you are ready.
Nothing personal, islander. The Arena wants fresh blood.
More of you? Good. The more that fall, the louder the Arena sings.
You fought well, cave-delver. Too well. The Arena will want to meet you.
Come, then, and see what we serve.
I slipped out through the side tunnel. Thank you for facing the king for me!
Those masks came out of the sea fog. Please, protect the village!
Rest well, wanderer. The arena will wait.
NORTH: the Old Road, the ruined courts, and the Hollow Cave. SOUTH: the village and the ferry.
HERE THE COURT OF THE TIDE KEPT ITS ORACLE. WHEN THE SEA ROSE THE KING WENT DOWN WITH HIS CROWN, AND THE HALL WAS SEALED.
Moss and salt have eaten the carvings, but a sunburst is still cut into the floor, pointing north toward the cave.
Cold air breathes out of the dark. The tunnel slopes down into the Hollow Crypt.
The Hooded Leader falls to one knee, laughing under the mask.
It is done. The gate is open, and you are the key.
The air above the square tears like cloth. A whirl of violet light drags at your feet...
You climb out into the daylight. Black smoke is rising over the village!
Shouts and the clash of steel carry on the wind. Hurry back to the square!
Paradise Island. A quiet morning in the village, though Elder Mahina looks worried by the old fire pit.
